generate_changelog_commits: generate a markdown changelog from categorized git commits with contributor credits
build_release_artifacts: build sdist and wheel Python release artifacts for a given semver version
bump_version_current_part: bump a semver version string by major, minor, or patch component
resolve_author_name_email: resolve a git author name and email to a GitHub @mention
run_release_dry_run: run the release script in dry-run mode to preview changelog and tag without publishing
